brief.headline: Push for ₹250/kg (market-fair price) — we're paying ₹1067.36/kg, 326.9% more than Silk Polypack and way above the open-market ask of ₹205–305/kg

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹250/kg on laminates, matching both Silk Polypack's price and the typical market ask for pharma-grade laminate
priceAsk.basis: We pay ₹1067.36/KG today, 326.9% above Silk Polypack's ₹250.00/KG. The open-market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), so our current price is far outside the fair band. Even the raw BOPET film import unit value is only 171.60 ₹/kg — we're paying for finished laminate at more than six times the substrate cost.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — it's not our worst term and won't move the needle much
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Cutting to 15 days would free up only ₹3158 for us — not worth trading away in this negotiation

brief.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki is healthy — they keep ₹5.20 of every ₹100 they sell, carry very little debt (0.11x), and are growing fast at 22.5% a year. We're tiny to them: our ₹76850 is 0.00% of their ₹2611.64 Cr in sales, so we have almost no pull on our own. That said, they want volume to fuel their growth. Our lever is not distress — it's the huge gap to market and the credible second sources we can line up. Offer to commit more volume or a longer contract in exchange for the market-fair price; if they won't move, walk the business to UFLEX or Constantia Parikh and use them as the second source.

evidence.point: Closing this gap saves us most of our annual spend with them

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant (₹16492.00 Cr revenue) that makes both film substrate AND converts it into finished laminate — can second-source at scale and give us a vertically integrated price

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter (₹222.04 Cr revenue) specializing in pharma blister and sachet laminates — a strong, proven second source

alternates.name: Amcor Flexibles India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Amcor's India arm — high-end pharma laminates, premium but very reliable for critical sachets

risks: We're 0.00% of their sales — on our own we have almost no leverage; bundle more volume, commit longer, or run a parallel RFQ to UFLEX and Constantia to create competitive pressure
The ₹1067.36/KG price is so far above market that it suggests we may be on a legacy rate or special small-lot surcharge — confirm MOQ and lead-time in the room before anchoring the ask
Huhtamaki is healthy and growing fast (22.5%) — they don't need our tiny order, so frame the ask as 'help us give you more volume at a market price' rather than a hard squeeze
If they won't move, be ready to walk the business to a vertically integrated converter (UFLEX) or a pharma-specialist (Constantia) and re-source within 90 days
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to grow our laminate spend with you, but today we're paying ₹1067 a kilo — more than four times what we pay Silk Polypack and way above the ₹205–305 market ask — so let's talk about moving to a market-fair ₹250 and committing more volume in return.
